query: I have messy debugging notes from a Postgres autovacuum wraparound stall last night - help me turn them into a clear postmortem blog post for backend engineers.
Draft an Architecture Decision Record comparing Server-Sent Events and WebSockets for our live build-log viewer, covering operational costs, failure modes, and rollback.
Our CLI tool's README takes six paragraphs of project history before showing how to install or run a command. Rewrite it so newcomers get a working result in two minutes.
Rewrite this chronological Q3 infrastructure status update into a one-page BLUF decision brief asking the VP of Engineering to approve two EU read replicas by Friday.
Help me write a direct, candid email to enterprise workspace admins explaining yesterday's 18-minute webhook delivery delay and the exact command to replay missed events.
Write UX error microcopy, empty-state text, and confirmation modal button labels for when an admin uploads an expired SAML certificate or revokes active production API keys.
Make this product launch post sound like a real engineer wrote it instead of an LLM - strip out 'seamless', 'pivotal', em dashes, and fake 'not just X, it's Y' pivots.
Critique my RFC draft on multi-region queue failover without rewriting it; tell me where the argument is thin, where modes collide, and which metrics lack baselines.
Separate the background design rationale out of our etcd snapshot restore runbook and tighten the operational steps so an on-call engineer can follow them at 3 a.m.
Draft landing-page hero and body copy for our open-source SQL migration linter aimed at data engineers who want to block table-locking DDL changes in pull requests.
Turn these benchmark notes on zero-copy Parquet streaming into a five-minute conference lightning talk script paired with assertive one-takeaway slide titles.
Run prose lint diagnostics on docs/architecture/overview.md to check sentence length variation, anchor density, passive voice rate, and any mechanical AI tells.
Debug why our async Python BufferedWriter drops the final 4 KB chunk when flushing gzipped NDJSON telemetry files on SIGTERM in src/worker/sink.py.
Write an idempotent PostgreSQL 16 SQL migration that builds a partial composite index concurrently on invoices(tenant_id, due_at) and sets lock_timeout to 2s.
Scan package-lock.json and audit the newly added postinstall scripts across node_modules for credential exfiltration, suspicious curl calls, or obfuscated payloads.
Scaffold a multi-stage Dockerfile and compose.yaml for a Go 1.23 gRPC ledger service using distroless non-root runtime images and grpc_health_probe checks.
Write a Python script using standard library zipfile and xml.etree.ElementTree to parse slide dimension attributes and embedded image byte sizes from a .pptx binary.
Configure ESLint flat config and Prettier in our TypeScript monorepo so import groups sort deterministically and pre-commit formatting checks run in GitHub Actions.
Review src/pool/dispatcher.rs for lock-ordering deadlocks and race conditions between the bounded Tokio mpsc receiver loop and graceful shutdown cancellation.
Write parameterized unittest cases and property-based checks verifying round-trip CBOR binary encoding for nested timezone-aware timestamps and uint64 IDs.
Write a ClickHouse SQL query computing 28-day rolling cohort retention and p95 query execution duration grouped by customer plan tier and region.
Show me the exact git bisect and cherry-pick commands to isolate a memory leak introduced between v2.4.0 and HEAD and backport the fix onto release/2.4.
Fix the CSS flexbox overflow bug in src/components/DataTable.tsx where pinned column headers misalign with horizontal scroll containers at 1280px width.
Generate Go server stubs and TypeScript fetch clients from proto/v1/settlement.proto using buf.gen.yaml and wire a deterministic codegen check into Makefile.
Draft a 5-section engineering one-pager for our reversible self-serve sandbox reset proposal with a BLUF call, measured baseline, explicit non-goals, status-quo tradeoffs, and kill switch.
Critique our OP1 six-pager and Working Backwards PR/FAQ before silent study hall - flag truism tenets that make no real sacrifice, blurred input vs output metrics, or appendix prose overflow.
Edit this architecture post in one pass to strip LLM flourishes like 'serves as a cornerstone', trailing ', highlighting...' clauses, 'The result?' pivots, and 'without sacrificing' claims.
Implement keyset pagination in our Go Postgres repository so the admin audit table fetches 50 rows per page without OFFSET scan slowdowns on six-million-row partitions.
Write a Python script using pypdfium2 that renders a six-page PDF invoice bundle into 150-DPI grayscale PNG thumbnails and uploads each page digest to S3.
Diagnose why Linux transparent hugepages allocation fails with ENOMEM on c6i.4xlarge Kubernetes nodes when launching JVM worker pods with -XX:+UseLargePages.
